newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell or liquidate 23 state firms - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell or liquidate 23 state firms - paper.

text.p: Brazil's government has prepared a list of 23 state-owned firms that it plans to eliminate, privatize or transfer to states and municipalities, O Globo newspaper today said.

O Globo said the list includes computer company Cobra, shipping firm Empresa de Navegacao da Amazonia, steel firm Companhia Siderurgica da Amazonia, data processing companies Datamec and Dataprev, among others.
Under the plan, the goverment aims to cut expenses with the maintenance of these companies, it added.
The newspaper also said the list was prepared by officials from the Planning and Finance ministries under the coordination of the government's chief of staff.
The Planning Ministry, which coordinates Brazil's privatization program, could not confirm the report.
